featured_reviews.name: Avinash Bhosale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Before joining Nikhil Sir's class I was just playing flute on some Bollywood songs, few bandish/gat in various Hindusthani classical raagas.

It has been more than year I am learning from Nikhil Sir. After joining Divine music school everything changed. This journey started by playing (mandra) Pa to (Madhya) Pa, back to basics. Daily practice of long notes for 15 minutes then playing Pa to Pa in 100 bpm speed and then increase the speed to 150 and then 200 bpm. Even though learning sessions are weekly, if I am not practicing daily, Nikhil Sir will immediately catch me. There is no alternative for hard work. Along with that Nikhil Sir used to give me 2-3 complex palatas to practice daily.

After six months my blowing of flute has improved and finger movements became lot of flexible as compared to the way i used to play earlier. This echoes what Nikhil Sir says "Flute is already a tuned instrument we just need to improve on blowing and finger movements".

Along with me, my family, friends started noticing the difference in the way I was playing flute. I even had an experience while buying an E-Base flute where the shop owner asked about my teacher. When I told him it was Nikhil Sir, he immediately said he had met few of his students and every one of them played beautifully.

Sir has been so patient with me, he will keep on repeating if I have not understood. Even then if I have not understood, then I request recording from sir and that worked for me.

If you're serious about learning the bansuri, I strongly recommend Nikhil Sir and Divine Music School. It’s not just a class—it’s a journey of transformation.

featured_reviews.name: Farah Surty
featured_reviews.review_text:
At 65, I finally gathered the courage to pursue a childhood dream I had carried in my heart for decades; to learn how to sing. Joining Ajivasan Music Academy has truly been a life-changing experience for me.

The environment here is warm, encouraging, and deeply inspiring. The teachers are not only skilled but also incredibly patient and supportive, making learning enjoyable at every step. They understand that passion has no age, and that belief reflects in the way they guide and nurture each student.

Another wonderful aspect is that the training is very affordable, making it accessible to everyone regardless of their social stature, without compromising on quality. The support staff is also extremely kind, helpful, and always ready to assist with a smile.

This academy has given wings to a dream I had almost forgotten. It has filled my days with joy, confidence, and a renewed sense of purpose. I am truly grateful to be part of this esteemed music academy under the able guidance of Padma Shri Suresh Wadkar ji and his better half Padma Wadkar Ma'am.

featured_reviews.name: harshal bedekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have learned a lot from the academy, and all the teachers teach us very well. The techniques and tricks they share are extremely helpful, especially for our practice. The labs and practice setups available here have helped us make a lot of progress because, apart from the classes, we also get a proper environment to practice regularly. We make full use of it, and it is really helping us improve.

Also, we would love to have more studio sessions, practical lectures, and guest lectures, as they would help us even more in developing our composing skills.

featured_reviews.name: Pradeep Tambe
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to sincerely appreciate the wonderful efforts of Hemant Bhosale Sir at Ajivasan Academy for his dedication to teaching tabla. His patience, clarity in explaining techniques, and passion for music truly inspire students to improve and enjoy the learning process. His classes are always engaging, and he ensures that every student progresses with confidence and strong fundamentals.

I would also like to extend my heartfelt gratitude to Kalyani Ma’am for her excellent guidance in singing. Her teaching style is encouraging, structured, and full of positive energy. She pays attention to every detail and helps students refine their skills while building confidence in their voice.

Both teachers create a very supportive and motivating learning environment. Their commitment and love for music make Ajivasan Academy a great place to learn and grow.

featured_reviews.name: Vikas Sharan
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience after having joined Ajivasan Musical Academy at Juhu last October, has been an enriching one👍🎶🎵! My search for a guru ended here in Ansh Upadhyay ji, who has the knowledge and requisite expertise to guide us in our musical journey. His finer nuances, classical approach to singing, introducing various ragas, alankaars, taal etc to us, while correcting the diction and methodology of singing different songs have been a strong guiding force for me. The Academy itself is very well structured with an immensely positive, clean and lively ambience! The staff are courteous and address our requirements adequately well. The monthly Karaoke sessions help us to understand singing on the pre-recorded track, cope up with stage fright in front of an audience and learn to appreciate others' singing. I am enjoying my time at Ajivasan and would encourage others to join based on their liking of Bollywood songs, light or heavy classical in vocals, dance or instrumentation🙂💐🙏.

featured_reviews.name: Asha Bhandarkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Can anyone imagine setting off to take up a graduation course in Hindustani Shaastriya Sangeet at the ripe old age of 68 !?! I wouldn't dare to, but somehow got pushed into it; destiny drew me to the steps of Ajivasan Academy, where I got sent straight to Ms Nehal's classroom; I smiled humbly, but not for too long! Soon I discovered Nehal ma'am to be a hard task master, a disciplinarian, a stickler for perfection. Yet I persevered & continued my journey with zeal; & I soon found my foothold in the Academy. With time, I had to inevitably accept my ma'am to be a tough protector, having a tough exterior with genuine empathy underneath.
My goal is years away, but today, at 72, I know I'm here to stay; I'm here, despite my recurrent absenteeism due to age related health challenges... yet striving happily through my 5th year to make my dreams come true.
Only you could make this happen @Ajivasan Academy, under the mentorship of Ms Nehal, your trusted teacher, who could hone my faculties thus. 🙏🙏

featured_reviews.name: Anna Sharafulina
featured_reviews.review_text:
First, they’ll bombard you with enrollment messages for weeks.

Then, they’ll give you the class timing a week in advance.

After that, they’ll confirm the location the evening before the class.

Then they’ll conveniently forget to inform you that the class has been rescheduled.

You’ll arrive on time, only to find a locked door, after planning your entire day around the class.

I can understand human factor of the receptionist. But then why play a show, like you are calling a teacher to know where he/she is and then say “actually you know what happened, the class was rescheduled” like I supposed to know about it. And I actually supposed to. From you. In advance.

The worst thing a school can do is relentlessly chase prospective students for enrollment and payment, only to completely disregard their time, effort, and money once they’ve signed up.

I rearranged my schedule, canceled other commitments, paid for transportation, and showed up at the exact time I was instructed to be there. Only after I arrived and multiple calls from my side was I told that the class timing had changed and that nobody had informed me.

Mistakes happen, but basic communication and respect for students’ time should be the minimum standard for any educational institution. Unfortunately, that was not my experience.
P.s. the school situated in a slum looking area in a quite dirty building, so vibe is not vibing. Can’t say anything about the teachers though, maybe they are nice.
Thank you.

name: Mindraga School of Music
description: Mindraga School of Music is a welcoming, song-first music approach where you start learning real songs from your very first class. We offer Guitar, Keyboard and Vocal training for kids, teens and adults—whether you’re a complete beginner or looking to level up your technique. Learn with an experienced, certified faculty and get structured preparation for Trinity exams, plus guidance on rhythm, ear training and music theory through practical, song-based learning. Book a free demo class and begin your music journey with confidence.

featured_reviews.name: Akash Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a great experience with MindRaga Music Classes. The team is very professional, supportive, and truly passionate about teaching music. They provide excellent training for both keyboard and guitar, making learning easy and enjoyable.
Another big advantage is the location, it’s in Andheri and very close to Andheri Railway Station, which makes it convenient for students to travel.
Highly recommended for anyone who wants to learn music from experienced professionals! 🎸🎹⭐

featured_reviews.name: Amit Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text: Learning music at Mindraga has been a great experience. The team is very professional but at the same time very approachable and supportive.I’m really impressed with the dedication of the Mindraga team.What I liked the most is the friendly and encouraging atmosphere they create during the sessions. It makes learning music feel exciting rather than stressful. A great place for anyone who wants to learn music seriously.

featured_reviews.name: Shahid Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Learning music with Shakti Sir at Mind Raga has been an incredible experience. He is a truly passionate teacher who brings a unique energy to every session. What sets him apart is his ability to make the technical aspects of music feel like total fun.

Despite being in a class setting, he provides a lot of individual attention, ensuring that you never feel lost. I’m honestly surprised by how much I’ve been able to learn and master in such a short amount of time. If you’re looking for a teacher who makes you fall in love with the process of learning, Shakti Sir is the one!

featured_reviews.name: Mrunal Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been learning music from MindRaga Music School for the past one month, and it has been a great experience. The curriculum is well-structured and easy to follow, and the teaching is very good. The instructors explain concepts clearly and make learning enjoyable. I can definitely recommend this to someone who wants to learn music.

featured_reviews.name: Aju Palleri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Learning to play keyboard at Mindraga Institute with experienced trainers Jay Talsania and Shakti has been fun and inspiring — their personalized sessions helped me confidently play several songs within just a few weeks.
I highly recommend Mindraga to anyone looking to start or strengthen their musical journey in a positive and encouraging environment.
